name: Radico Khaitan Ltd
title: Radico Khaitan Ltd - 532497 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 gross margin 48% (+450bp) and EBITDA margin 19% on premiumisation; guides FY27 P&A volume +20% and 120–125bp margin expansion, with capex only INR 150–175 crores and no supply constraint flagged.

capex.quote: The capex as I said will be in the range of INR 150 crores to INR 175 crores which will be largely on my internal capacity expansion and optimization

triggers.label: Gross margin 48%, +450bp YoY
triggers.quote: gross margin during the quarter was 48%, representing an expansion of 450 basis points on year -on-year basis

triggers.label: FY27 EBITDA margin +120–125bp
triggers.quote: we are quite confident to add 120 basis points to 125 basis points margins in the coming year ‘27

triggers.label: Glass prices up ~15% in last month
triggers.quote: there has been some inflation in the glass prices in the last month; around 15% of the glass price has increased

triggers.label: Capex INR 150–175 cr, capacity not a constraint
triggers.quote: But the capacity is not a constraint for growth.

guidance.quote: we expect to grow our Prestige & Above portfolio volume by 20%
we are quite confident to add 120 basis points to 125 basis points margins in the coming year ‘27
we are confident that our luxury portfolio should grow by 25% in terms of value from INR 475 crores
for next year, we expect 3% to 5% volume growth in regular category
The capex as I said will be in the range of INR 150 crores to INR 175 crores
we are on track to become debt -free in H1 FY27
the Board has articulated a strong dividend policy with a minimum payout of 20% of profit after tax

red_flags.label: Glass inflation ~15% and West Asia/LPG supply risk
red_flags.quote: there has been some inflation in the glass prices in the last month; around 15% of the glass price has increased

red_flags.label: Q4 regular volume degrowth, Maharashtra IMFL down 20–25%
red_flags.quote: after the MML introduction the IMFL industry has gone down; it has gone down by 20%, 25%

evasions.quote: I cannot say that which are the states, but yes, it is an ongoing process.
since the policy is yet not out, so we cannot comment
